title: 探险大师
concept: 金色旅行箱背小喷气背包准备探险
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art for achievement_medal_travel_tier_005, to be converted into a transparent 768x768 app asset
Primary request: Create one absurd but premium collectible travel achievement medal for the Chinese title concept "探险大师" (adventure master who somehow never pays). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a chunky beveled gold rim and a glossy turquoise enamel center. Main visual gag: ONE shiny gold travel suitcase wearing a tiny jetpack backpack, leaning forward with confident explorer energy. The jetpack is small and toy-like, with simple glowing thrust shapes as light effects only. The suitcase remains the dominant readable shape.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, playful deliberate nonsense, premium material finish, raised gold metal, glossy enamel, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: dynamic but simple silhouette, suitcase centered and dominant, tiny jetpack readable, full medal visible with generous padding, no cropping.
Lighting/mood: bold adventure comedy, bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, energetic but not chaotic.
Color palette: saturated metallic gold suitcase, electric turquoise enamel, red or orange jetpack accents, coral or ruby rim accents, white and yellow glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, small metal jetpack, simple light effects, beveled rim, smooth hand-painted shading. No paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no maps, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no camera, no neck pillow, no blanket, no airplane, no seat, no drink cup, no globe, no mountains, no fireball, no explosion, no smoke cloud, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no postage stamp edge, no paper texture, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
